qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the plug for high pressure section of injection pump?
What screw type is used for the distributor injection pump to holder connection?
What torque value should be applied to the electric shutoff to injection pump?
What is the torque specification for the electric cold start valve to injection pump?
Which component has the highest torque specification on this page?
qa_pairs.answer: The pressure valve holder to injection pump at 45 Nm

qa_pairs.question: What torque should be applied to the distributor injection pump to flange and console?
What is the lowest torque specification listed on this page?
qa_pairs.answer: 2.5 Nm for the electrical line on fuel cutout device

qa_pairs.question: What screw type is used for the electrical line on fuel cutout device?
What section of the service manual does this page cover?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 13-4 Fuel delivery and metering system, specifically the Injection Pump Control receptacle
